title: Bebe Ridley's health and Gallaud's 1958 operation
summary: Bebe Ridley is out in the country and healthy; Gallaud says he was operated on in March 1958 and still suffers from it.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: He still seems to be healthy now. He was sick a while, but he's…
Yeah, I got operated on above. Me, I got operated on in March the 15th. Just last? The 58.
I remember hearing you were sick there once, but I didn't know.
I was very sick. I'd like to win. I got a big cut and I suffer with it now most of the time.
